findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. These values are stored in Terraform state and Lambda configuration and can be exposed to users or systems able to read them; use an execution role and a secrets service instead.
The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Deploying code on this obsolete runtime increases exposure to known runtime vulnerabilities.
